newsitem.title: USA: Liberty Financial sets second offering price.
newsitem.headline: Liberty Financial sets second offering price.

text.p: Liberty Financial Co Inc said Friday a price of $52.50 per share has been agreed to by the underwriters and the selling stockholders in its secondary public offering of 2.5 million shares of its common stock.

These shares will be sold by an indirect subsidiary of Liberty Mutual Insurance Co and certain other stockholders of Liberty Financial pursuant to a registration statement declared effective Friday by the Securities and Exchange Commission, the company said.
The closing for the offering is scheduled for Wednesday, July 23.
Net proceeds of the offering for the selling stockholders will be about $125 million, the company said.

Managing underwriters for the offering are Merrill Lynch & Co., Goldman, Sachs & Co., PaineWebber Incorporated and Fox-Pitt, Kelton, Inc, it said. Managing underwriters for the international portion of the offering are Merrill Lynch International, Goldman, Sachs International, PaineWebber International and Fox-Pitt, Kelton N.V.
